items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are clear (flushChunk, readNextChunk, decodeBase64Key, ensureHeader) and the formatting matches the repo. But no exported API has a doc comment (NewEncryptor, EncryptWriter, DecryptReader, Config, LoadKey), and the frame/HMAC layout logic has no inline comments.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Leftover dead code `func (job Job) validate() error { return job.Validate() }` with no callers. The AES/GCM setup is copy-pasted between NewEncryptor and DecryptReader. LoadKey repeats Validate's source switch. The 439-line file is otherwise well split.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Errors are wrapped with %w and ErrInvalidKey. Chunk lengths are bounds-checked, truncation is detected, hmac.Equal is used, constants are named, and the key loads before storages. Minor issues: a second Close returns nil after a failed first Close, and LoadKey forces `cfg.Enabled = true`.

items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
items.evidence: Mandated signatures are changed and callers compile. PathGenerator hardcodes `EnsureFileName(filename, gzip, false, unique)`, so storage tests didn't need updating. Unencrypted filenames change in one case: `hadEnc` keeps a trailing .enc when shouldEncrypt is false, so x.enc with gzip now becomes x.gz.enc instead of x.enc.gz.
